name: photo-grid-collage
description: Arrange photos into a collage or grid poster: a 3×3 nine-grid, 2×2, one big photo with smaller ones around it, an even auto grid, a justified mosaic that never crops, or a vertical strip. Choose the canvas (square, 4:5 post, story, landscape, A4 poster or a custom size), gap, margin, rounded corners, background, a title and a footer, and put a caption on any photo. Each photo has an order (which slot it gets) and a crop focus, so faces and products stay in frame. Before you export you are told when a fixed grid has empty or unused slots, when a small photo will look blurry in a big cell, when a crop cuts away most of a photo, and which files can't be read. Exports PNG and JPG. Runs locally; no account or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把多张照片拼成拼图或海报：3×3 九宫格、2×2 四宫格、一张大图配几张小图、自动均匀网格、不裁切的瀑布拼接，或者竖条。可以选画布（方形、4:5 帖子、竖屏、横版、A4 海报或自定义尺寸），调间距、外边距、圆角、背景色，加标题和底部文字，给任意一张加说明。每张照片可以设顺序（放在哪个格子）和裁切焦点，人脸和商品不会被切掉。导出前会提示：固定格数的版式有空格或多出来的照片、小图放进大格子会糊、裁切掉了大半张照片、哪些文件读不出来。导出 PNG 和 JPG。在本地运行，不用登录，无需 API 密钥。
